title: GUI Project Detail Auto Update - Rework 2
outcome_summary: This rework cycle resolved all 8 deferred items and 4 follow-up recommendations from rework-1 via four purely internal improvements to the MCP Server GUI: a micro-cleanup batch (JSDoc, defensive null checks, guard simplifications), strict TypeScript typing for the MakeProjectOpts fixture interface, splitting a 1,479-line test monolith into three focused self-contained files, and decomposing the 1,886-line project-detail.js into four sub-modules using a globalThis shared-state pattern. All 4 WPs completed 16/16 pipeline stages with zero rework cycles and 3,214 tests passing throughout; no new product features were introduced.
